articles.title: Mystery of Laos's Plain of Jars Solved: They Were Massive Burial Vessels
articles.summary: A newly discovered jar containing 37 individuals confirms that the Plain of Jars in Laos was a vast burial complex. The finding ends decades of speculation about the jars' purpose.

articles.title: Quantum Leap: How Atom-Thin Materials Unite Light and Magnetism
articles.summary: A new review in Nature Materials reveals how excitons and magnons interact in van der Waals magnetic semiconductors, enabling optical control of magnetism and paving the way for advanced quantum devices.

articles.title: Gravitational Wave GW250114 Reveals Black Hole's Event Horizon Secrets
articles.summary: An exceptionally loud gravitational wave signal from a black hole merger allowed astrophysicists to directly measure the rotation frequency and surface gravity of the final black hole's event horizon for the first time.
